content.subject: Fw: Media Advisory - Media Availability with Commissioner of Baseball Robert D. Manfred, Jr.

content.text:
From: Myers, Gene <gmyers@freepress.com>
Sent: Monday, June 1, 2015 5:24 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: Media Advisory - Media Availability with Commissioner of Baseball Robert D. Manfred, Jr. 
 
AF: Hmmm. And there will be word on JV’s next mound appearance, right? … Just stay away Wednesday and Thursday. … Maybe help Perry by chasing Victor or JV.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Monday, June 01, 2015 5:15 PM
To: Myers, Gene
Subject: Re: Media Advisory - Media Availability with Commissioner of Baseball Robert D. Manfred, Jr.
If I didn't meet the commish, I would be in violation of Section 2, Article A of John's rules to live by.
Plus, Victor is going to be there.
Anthony Fenech
Detroit Free Press
Tigers beat writer
Twitter: @anthonyfenech

From: Myers, Gene
Sent: Monday, June 1, 2015 5:06 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: RE: Media Advisory - Media Availability with Commissioner of Baseball Robert D. Manfred, Jr.
ANTHONY: Perry has the team. Drew has the commish. … You can be off. (Unless you want to go meeting the commissioner. If that’s so, go to the presser – and then leave Comerica!)

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Monday, June 01, 2015 5:05 PM
To: Myers, Gene
Subject: Re: Media Advisory - Media Availability with Commissioner of Baseball Robert D. Manfred, Jr.
So much for my day off.
Anthony Fenech
Detroit Free Press
Tigers beat writer
Twitter: @anthonyfenech

From: Myers, Gene
Sent: Monday, June 1, 2015 4:28 PM
To: Farrell, Perry
Cc: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: FW: Media Advisory - Media Availability with Commissioner of Baseball Robert D. Manfred, Jr.
PERRY: FYI … Drew will cover the Commish at the Tigers tomorrow afternoon while you’re with the team.
Thanks.

From: Sharp, Drew 
Sent: Monday, June 01, 2015 4:27 PM
To: Myers, Gene
Subject: Re: Media Advisory - Media Availability with Commissioner of Baseball Robert D. Manfred, Jr.
I shall be there.
Sent from my iPhone
On Jun 1, 2015, at 4:01 PM, Myers, Gene <gmyers@freepress.com> wrote:
DREW: You wanna columnize tomorrow off this? Thanks.

Sent: Monday, June 01, 2015 3:59 PM
To: Myers, Gene
Subject: FW: Media Advisory - Media Availability with Commissioner of Baseball Robert D. Manfred, Jr.

**MEDIA ADVISORY**
WHAT:        Media Availability with Commissioner of Baseball Robert D. Manfred, Jr.
WHO:                Commissioner of Baseball Robert D. Manfred, Jr.
WHEN:        Tuesday, June 2, 2015, 3:00 p.m.

WHERE:        Interview Room 2                 
                Comerica Park                                 
                2100 Woodward Ave.                         
                Detroit, MI 48201
NOTE:        Commissioner of Baseball Robert D. Manfred, Jr. will be available to the media at 3:00 p.m. on Tuesday, June 2, in Interview Room 2.

Media wishing to attend should enter through the Administrative Lobby on Montcalm. All media members wishing to attend must have credentials issued through the Tigers or Major League Baseball. Media parking is available in lot number three, located on Montcalm. Media members needing parking should send requests to Michele Wysocki (michele.wysocki@detroittigers.com).
CONTACT:        Tigers Media Relations, 313-471-2000
